curated-fs-quilon-gf-grenze: Commanding yet dignified, Quilon could front a yoga studio logo while Grenze sets the text beneath it. Its classic serif body is tall and tightly spaced, so it is not meant for long paragraphs.
curated-fs-quilon-roboto-slab: Quilon swells and thins in a soft, unhurried step from heavy to light. Roboto Slab follows with a sturdy, slab-serif body whose dominant middle zone makes a long stretch of text feel firmly structured and easy to trust.
curated-fs-rajdhani-gf-alegreya-sc: Rajdhani draws its curves as thick as its stems, crisp and modern. Alegreya SC then settles in as a text serif with a wide s and faint hairline thinning, giving a longer passage a traditional, authoritative cadence, fine even for a grocery list.
curated-fs-rajdhani-gf-arapey: Modern and clean, Rajdhani keeps every line flat like a fineliner. Arapey's strength is the drama inside each letter, a heavy trunk with whisper-thin branches, which makes a handful of lines look polished.
curated-fs-rajdhani-gf-bacasime-antique: Crisp, uniform strokes up top, then a serif with heavy verticals and hairline connections. Rajdhani keeps the headline sharp while Bacasime Antique brings an authoritative editorial weight, and its tight clustering is not meant for long paragraphs.
curated-fs-rajdhani-gf-diphylleia: Smooth as a pen-plotter line, clean and modern. Rajdhani is best at crisp, single-width headings, whereas Diphylleia, a text serif with open apertures, does its finest work in small sizes with a gentle thick-thin rhythm.
curated-fs-rajdhani-gf-libertinus-serif: Libertinus Serif brings refined authority, with a slight swell on its bowls and an open counter on the s. Rajdhani does its best work with a modern, uniform y whose tail matches its arm, while Libertinus Serif slims those joins yet stays comfortably sturdy.
curated-fs-rajdhani-gf-nanum-myeongjo: Nanum Myeongjo brings quiet modulation and curves that stop short of touching. Rajdhani, with no stress at all in its curves, contrasts it nicely, while the text serif body gives a longer stretch of reading a refined, editorial feel.
curated-fs-red-hat-display-baskervville: Marker-bold lines with daylight in every curve. Red Hat Display is best at that constant-width, contemporary punch, while Baskervville, a text serif with hairline crossbars and a small, low-set lowercase, handles the dignified, graceful reading.
curated-fs-red-hat-display-fs-recia: Red Hat Display cuts its letters like a fixed-width router bit, contemporary and bold, with generous openings throughout. Recia follows with a gentle thick-thin rhythm that keeps a longer passage sharp and authoritative.
